{{Quote|If you ask me, it's the only way.''"<br />"''I agree, Hilly. Princess Leia's plan is sound.|Hilly and a rebel discuss Princess Leia's proposal to hide the Rebel fleet in the Arbran sun|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 58">[[Star Wars (1977) 58|''Star Wars'' (1977) 58]]</ref>}}
'''Hilly''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] stationed at [[Haven Base|the base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The Rebel was part of the strategy meeting of Alliance personnel where [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] proposed to hide the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance fleet]] within the [[chromosphere]] of the [[Arbran]] [[Star/Legends|sun]].

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Hilly was created by [[Marvel Comics]] writer, [[David Michelinie]]. The only mention of Hilly occurs by a Rebel soldier off panel, keeping Hilly's identity and gender in doubt. However, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' identifies Hilly as a male, disproving a rumor that Hilly was a woman in the comic who agreed with Organa's support of the plan.
